instruction: Candid cinematic photograph, medium close-up. Indoors near a bright window with sheer white curtains, a couple dances tango. The woman in the black halter dress (R2) is in the foreground with her back to the camera, showing a blue flower bun accessory. The man in the grey suit (R1) stands opposite her, looking down with a soft expression. They hold hands raised to the side in a classic dance frame. Soft backlighting from the window creates a warm, slightly silhouetted atmosphere.
